message.content: how does RAG relate to hybrid retrieval?

content.text: RAG grounds a language model in an external corpus (Source: [[Retrieval-Augmented Generation]]). Most modern systems augment naive RAG with lexical retrieval — see [[Hybrid Retrieval]] — and fuse the two rankings using [[Reciprocal Rank Fusion]]. The same [[Retrieval-Augmented Generation]] page is cited a second time here to test dedup within a turn.
